US Iran War: US President Donald Trump has ruled out a strike on Iran for Sunday as Washington weighs a possible deal or further military action. Tehran says the door to diplomacy remains open but accuses the US of making one-sided demands. Meanwhile, regional powers are stepping up diplomatic efforts to ease tensions as military threats and security concerns persist across the Middle East.
